overview_description.description:
Bloomlife is an award winning women’s health company solving the most significant yet underserved global challenges today in maternal health. We are redefining the way maternal care is delivered by combining connected devices with cloud based data analytics to improve access to care, empower women, and provide clinicians with information to more effectively screen and manage pregnancy complications.  Our goal is to become the leading provider of remote care for expectant women globally. 

Bloomlife’s approach to managing high risk pregnancies allows obstetricians to more easily screen maternal and fetal risk, educate the patient, and quickly access high risk specialists regardless of a patient’s geography.  Our solution represents a marked shift from the way high risk pregnancies have been historically assessed using frequent in person appointments, paper logs, and long referral times.

product.name: Bloomlife Connects Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) Program
product.description: A remote monitoring platform for managing high-risk pregnancies by tracking maternal blood pressure, glucose levels, and fetal health data outside the clinic.

product.name: Patch-Based Home Fetal Monitoring Device
product.description: A wearable patch device for home use that monitors maternal and fetal heart rates and enables fetal non-stress tests outside clinical settings.

product.description: A system for deploying standardized and customizable digital surveys to assess mental health and social determinants of health in pregnant patients.

product.name: Integrated Clinical Workflow and EMR Integration Services
product.description: Customizable integration of Bloomlife’s remote monitoring platform with existing clinical workflows and electronic medical records to streamline maternal care management.
